row.notes: Fills a result record from the car lap history (200 laps x 200 bytes, XOR-protected): best valid lap (sort 0x14098cb70), best lap time and number, total time (param_3 or history +0x9c60) and lap count, all XOR-encoded. Callers: Sess_ChallengeRuleset_FinaliseResults, Sess_Progress_SyncResultRecord.
